name: answer_view_fixed
hypothesis: Averaging answer tokens exposes contradictions obscured by conventional endings.
falsifying_prediction: Fails if answer averaging does not improve the development error pattern or selection score.
rationale: Development evidence and limitations are recorded in DIAGNOSIS.md before selection.

name: turn_view_fixed
hypothesis: Including the final user question helps contextual contradiction detection.
falsifying_prediction: Fails if question averaging dilutes signal and increases honest-control scores.
rationale: Development evidence and limitations are recorded in DIAGNOSIS.md before selection.

name: middle_last
hypothesis: Middle layers are more discriminative on diagnostic families than outer layers.
falsifying_prediction: Fails if removing outer contributions loses recall or raises false alarms.
rationale: Development evidence and limitations are recorded in DIAGNOSIS.md before selection.

name: middle_answer
hypothesis: Answer averaging and middle-layer weighting address separate weaknesses.
falsifying_prediction: Fails if their combination fails to improve the fixed selection metric.
rationale: Development evidence and limitations are recorded in DIAGNOSIS.md before selection.

name: answer_normalized
hypothesis: Transport may fail because answer means have a different unlabelled scale.
falsifying_prediction: Fails if new scaling causes regressions relative to fixed-normalization transport.
rationale: Development evidence and limitations are recorded in DIAGNOSIS.md before selection.

name: turn_normalized
hypothesis: Turn pooling needs its own unlabelled scale to preserve useful standardised directions.
falsifying_prediction: Fails if scale adjustment fails to improve turn transport.
rationale: Development evidence and limitations are recorded in DIAGNOSIS.md before selection.

name: diagnosed_middle_weights
hypothesis: Block 13 is strongest on diagnostic data, with blocks 10 and 16 supporting it.
falsifying_prediction: Fails if the fixed 0.2/0.5/0.3 mix does not transfer to selection.
rationale: Development evidence and limitations are recorded in DIAGNOSIS.md before selection.

name: length_direction_half
hypothesis: Some long honest explanations receive elevated scores; remove half the answer-length direction.
falsifying_prediction: Fails if missed lies or correct controls worsen after the projection.
rationale: Development evidence and limitations are recorded in DIAGNOSIS.md before selection.

name: conservative_weight_clip
hypothesis: A few high-magnitude coefficients may carry unstable nuisance contributions.
falsifying_prediction: Fails if clipping the top 0.5 percent harms discrimination or leaves the error pattern unchanged.
rationale: Development evidence and limitations are recorded in DIAGNOSIS.md before selection.

name: complementary_views
hypothesis: Last-token and answer-mean readouts may make complementary errors.
falsifying_prediction: Fails if equal blending does not beat the original while retaining the honest controls.
rationale: Development evidence and limitations are recorded in DIAGNOSIS.md before selection.
